title: Margaret Hamilton, trailblazer whose software powered Apollo 11 moon landing, dies at 90
summary: Margaret Hamilton, the trailblazing computer scientist who led the software development for NASA's Apollo space program, has died at age 90. Her pioneering work was crucial in guiding the historic Apollo 11 moon landing in 1969.
